newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Fu Hui directors mull selling stake.
newsitem.headline: Fu Hui directors mull selling stake.

text.p: Fu Hui Jewellery Company (H.K.) Ltd said on Thursday several directors of the company were discussing the proposed sale of their shareholdings.

The company said in a published announcement that directors Chu Kwok Fai, Chan Shui Chu, and Lau Hau Wah, who together hold 29.7 percent of Fu Hui, had been in discussion to sell their shares to an independent third party since November 4.
Chu Kwok fai is a substantial shareholder and together with his wife Chan Shui Chu holds 21.5 percent of the issued share capital of the company.
The negotiations were proceeding on the basis that the proposed purchase of the shares would not require a general offer for all the shares of the company.
The announcement said the negotiations were at a preliminary stage and that no binding agreement had been reached between the parties.
Trading in the shares, which was suspended on Wednesday, resumed on Thursday.
The shares were untraded at HK$0.53 in early morning.
